item.text: CodeGraph’s telemetry is anonymous, aggregate usage telemetry: active machines, agent clients, install targets, tool/CLI usage and errors, indexed languages, version/platform mix, SQLite backend share, and CI tagging. Its privacy promise is local-first: user code never leaves the machine, and telemetry must never include source code, file paths/names, repo names, symbol names, query/search terms, or anything derived from indexed project contents. It uses a random machine ID, not a hardware fingerprint, and the ingest worker allowlists fields, strips unknown properties, and does not log or forward client IPs.
